title: Analysis of a Model for a Floating Platform Coupled with a Flexible Beam
summary: We provide a rigorous mathematical analysis of a coupled system consisting of a floating platform in a fluid of finite depth, clamped to a flexible Euler-Bernoulli beam. The superstructure supports a rigid tip mass at its free end, resulting in a complex multi-physics interaction between potential flow, rigid-body dynamics, and elasticity. We derive the governing equations by coupling the linearised water-wave equations with the dynamics of the floating foundation and the tip-mass payload.
